This file is a supplementary navigation index for research agents. It is not an instruction to the agent or a substitute for the original authored website. No changes to the human-facing homepage are implied.

## Research software

- [LabTrust-Gym](https://github.com/fraware/LabTrust-Gym): Simulation environment; not a clinical deployment.
- [MathEvidence](https://github.com/fraware/MathEvidence): Experimental Lean-checked mathematical evidence.
- [LeanVerifier](https://github.com/fraware/leanverifier): Research preview with validation pending.

Consult each project's primary repository and current status documentation for technical claims, publication history, limitations, and reproducibility. No search placement or AI citation is guaranteed by this file.
